rules.label: Mobile app and On SoundCloud teasers

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides SoundCloud's home banners, hero and Go+ badges; blur artwork and card text; hide the trending strip
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA on soundcloud.com (home page), DOM captured after 7 seconds. Fixtures `real.html` (phone) and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts of that DOM: text stripped, only the ancestors the selectors need, `data-keep` on the main content, the Sign in button and the mini-player.

LIVE desktop home: `.l-product-banners` 1 (the get-heard banner, has its own close button), `.l-front-hero` 1, `.l-front-mobile-teaser` 1, `.l-front-osc-teaser` 1, `.playableTile__tierIndicator` 15, `.sc-artwork` 30, `.playableTile__artwork` 15, `.image__full` 15, `.playableTile__mainHeading` 15, `.playableTile__usernameHeading` 15, `.playableTile__description` 15, `.trendingTracks` 1. The original cookie rule matched the OneTrust elements (2) on both phone and desktop, and the ad rule matched the `div-gpt-ad-interstitial` slot (1); the original app-banner rule matched nothing.

Choices: Cover artwork Show/Blur and Card titles and names Show/Blur. Class names are SoundCloud's readable component classes (playableTile, frontHero, sc-artwork); no hashed classes.

SOURCE: uBlock users hide the Go+ and Next Pro upsell buttons and the upload quota meter (annieversary blog, synthead/soundcloud-adfree list); those elements only exist when logged in and were not verified here.

NOT verified: logged-in pages; track and playlist pages (the sidebar upsell modules, comments, the waveform); the phone home page beyond the cookie wall (the phone DOM only held the consent dialog).
